class.name: ECSSerializer
class.brief_description: The persistence backbone for ECS world data and state synchronization.
class.description: [ECSSerializer] provides a suite of tools for converting the in-memory ECS registry into persistent formats. It is designed to handle both full "Game Save" worlds and lightweight "Network Deltas". The serializer uses a high-performance binary format that preserves the generational integrity of entities and the precise alignment of component data. It is capable of saving/loading millions of entities in milliseconds, bypassing the serialization overhead of standard Godot [Resource]s. [b]Feature Set:[/b] - [b]Full Snapshots:[/b] Complete world dumps for cold-storage saves. - [b]Delta Compression:[/b] Calculates the difference between two states, saving only modified components. Ideal for multiplayer replication. - [b]Binary Blobs:[/b] Memory-direct serialization for high-speed Undo/Redo or rollback networking. [b]Note:[/b] The serializer automatically handles component registration differences; if a component type is removed from the engine code, its data in old save files will be safely skipped during load.

method.name: save_world
method.description: Serializes the entire [EntityManager] state to a binary file at [param path]. Returns [constant OK] on success, or an error code if the file cannot be written. This operation is blocking and should typically be performed in a background thread for large worlds.

method.name: save_delta
method.description: Compares the current world state against a previously captured [param baseline] snapshot and saves only the changes. This significantly reduces save file size for incremental progress.

method.name: load_world
method.description: Clears the current [EntityManager] and reconstructs it entirely from the binary data at [param path]. Existing entities and components are destroyed before the load begins. [b]Warning:[/b] This is a destructive operation.

method.name: capture_snapshot
method.description: Creates a [Dictionary] representation of the world. Each key is an entity ID and the value is a nested dictionary of its components. Perfect for JSON-based debug reporting or web-based world viewers.

method.name: capture_snapshot_binary
method.description: Returns the current state as a raw [PackedByteArray]. This is the most efficient way to store world state for short-term persistence like checkpointing or networking.

method.name: apply_snapshot_delta
method.description: Patches the current world state using a binary delta blob. Entities and components NOT mentioned in the delta are left unchanged. This is the primary method for high-performance server-to-client updates.
